# Riding the Passion Wave or Fighting to Stay Afloat? A Theory of Differentiated Passion Contagion

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Jon M. Jachimowicz, Joyce He, Celia Moore  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Administrative Science Quarterly  
**DOI:** [10.1177/00018392251399652](https://doi.org/10.1177/00018392251399652)  
**Publisher:** [https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/00018392251399652](https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/00018392251399652)

**Keywords:** passion contagion, emotions, organizational behavior, differentiated theory, employee engagement

## Abstract

Develops a theory of differentiated passion contagion explaining how passion spreads differently across organizational members, with some riding the wave of collective enthusiasm while others struggle to stay afloat.
